iterations.label: Iteration 3 · actual gameplay

iterations.summary: Added a skinned character with expressive joint poses, layered materials, botanical architecture and static geometry batching. Portrait framing improved; a fresh moving review found an upcoming exit entering view too late.

iterations.label: Iteration 4 · inspected review candidate
iterations.title: A connected world, with the next landing in view
iterations.summary: Added terraced cliff islands, lower galleries and distant settlements. The camera uses the real route cursor, anticipates the following landing and keeps a stable scale. iterations.verdict: The fresh critic no longer reproduced the earlier exit clipping in sampled floor-004 traversal. The benchmark remains not passed: district composition, surface finish and expressive motion still trail the reference.

iterations.label: Iteration 5 · interface-only verification
iterations.title: A quieter HUD, a clearer expedition
iterations.summary: Replaced the pale full-frame wash with compact dark-green panels and gold progress, improved portrait/short-landscape layouts and added a keyboard-safe Journey dialog. Current floor, cleared floors, district and checkpoint read only the live application output. Settings now have accessible switches. Ten UI-harness checks and six Node server/asset checks pass; the new module is explicitly allowlisted.
iterations.verdict: Self-reviewed only. The coding workspace was offline; the actual 3D game and independent reference comparison were not rerun. No ASTRO BOT win or production claim.
